What is Multi-Channel Network (MCN)?

Multi-Channel Network (MCN) incubate and support creators within the TikTok Shop ecosystem. This type of partner supports creators in various aspects, including shoppable video content creation, shoppable livestream operations, and creator-product matchmaking for affiliate programs.

What are the benefits of becoming a MCN on TikTok Shop？

Collaboration Opportunities

  • MCN members gain access to exciting collaboration opportunities with renowned sellers and brands. This opens doors to innovative and mutually beneficial partnerships.

Generous Commission

  • MCN are generously rewarded for their role in acquiring, educating, and incubating creators.

Professional Growth Guidance

  • Custom guidance and creator training for achieving fast growth

Custom Services

  • High-performing MCN receive dedicated support, tailored to their unique needs and objectives.
